reference: GCF_049306965.1; 25 nuclear chromosomes; frozen TU 49 large regions
score_definition: reciprocal periodic edit similarity; not SD native alignment identity
normalized_edit_distance: sum pairwise global Levenshtein distances / sum pairwise maximum sequence lengths; then equal weighting of regional estimates
retained_coverage: all eligible copies / annotated satellite bases within frozen large regions; distinct from sampled sequence coverage
coordinates: TSV raw unit start0/end0 are zero-based, half-open; manuscript coordinates are one-based inclusive
fresh_recomputation: Extract into a new directory with inputs and code. Omit existing results and checks, or move them aside before executing; completed per-chromosome results are otherwise reused.
limits: Existing decomposition boundaries and templates retained
Fixed Edlib NW path within each optimal start/span pair; not all tied gap paths enumerated
Descriptive region summaries; no claim of homogenization rate or functional centromere activity
